title: Cookie Policy
intro: A cookie is a small file a site leaves in your browser. Here is every kind we use and what each one is for.

sections.heading: Strictly necessary
text: These keep the site working: they remember your basket, keep forms secure, and - a little circularly - remember the cookie choice you made so we stop asking.
They cannot be switched off, because without them the site cannot do what you came for.

sections.heading: Analytics
text: Anonymous counts of which pages get read and how people arrive. It tells us what to write more of.
Off by default. Nothing analytics-related loads until you switch it on.

sections.heading: Marketing
text: Lets us show our own offers to people who have visited before.
Off by default, and no data is ever sold or handed to an advertising network to resell.

sections.heading: How long your choice lasts
text: If you accept, we remember it for a year. If you decline everything, we only remember that for about a day - so we will ask again, rather than quietly assuming forever.
Clearing your browser's cookies resets the question entirely.

sections.heading: Changing your mind
text: Use the cookie link in the footer at any time. The panel opens with your current choices already shown, and saving takes effect immediately - no reload needed.

contact.heading: Not sure about something?
contact.text: Ask us and we will tell you exactly what a given cookie does.
